name: Subgraph Edge Counting
description: I redefined the deadlock condition from mutual connections to a global counting property: a trio of workers where exactly 3 incident files contain only workers from that trio. This is mathematically identical to a triangle (K3), but the phrasing strongly encourages a literal O(n^3 * m) implementation that will fail the time limit, rather than the intended O(m * deg) graph traversal.
